steps.note: Netty 4.2's strict line parsing (HttpObjectDecoder defaultStrictLineParsing): a line ended by a bare LF, or a request starting with a control character, fails the decoder with InvalidLineSeparatorException; a decoder failure after the connection's first request is logged once (EarlyMatchingHandler has detached)
keep-alive Transfer-Encoding gzip without Content-Length: the body is empty and its bytes are read as the next request, which starts with 0x1f
an invalid version on the connection's second request: logged once
a request line ended by a bare LF: the invalid message, logged twice on the first request
a header line ended by a bare LF: the request keeps the headers before the one pending
a blank line that is a bare LF
a bare LF in a header line of the second request
CR and LF bytes before a request line are skipped, in any order
